_what: Enforcement ledger for the EXTENSION HOST dependency rules (webview files are enforced by webview-architecture-rules.test.ts under ADR-017). The keys map to rules that live in different records since the 2026-08-30 split: fetchBoundary and constructionBoundary -> ADR-015; compositionPointLifetime -> ADR-020; commandBase and typesPurity -> the development handbook (no ADR — neither has a rejected alternative worth recording). Every entry is a KNOWN pre-ruling violation with its reason. The test fails on (a) any violation NOT listed here, (b) any listed entry that no longer violates (the ledger only shrinks), (c) any entry without a reason. Cleaning a file = fixing it AND deleting its row.

commandBase.src/commands/commandManager.ts:CommandMa: the command REGISTRAR, not a command — exempt by role. RATIFIED as permanent: it builds and registers the 25 commands, so it cannot itself be one of them. Reviewed 2026-08-31 when the other row in this category was cleared; this is the only member left and it is not debt.

typesPurity.src/types/typeGuards.ts: RATIFIED by the owner 2026-08-31. Runtime type guards colocated with the types they narrow, and genuinely runtime: needs COMPONENT_IDS, getMeshAppBuilderComponent, deriveAccsAdminUrl, lookupComponentConfigValue and two endpoint constants as VALUES — measured by converting every import in the file to type-only and reading tsc. A type guard is the one kind of runtime code that belongs beside its types; separating it would make the guards harder to find and they are imported very widely. PERMANENT EXCEPTION, not debt.

layerDirection.src/core/di/serviceLocator.ts: RATIFIED by the owner 2026-08-31. A service locator has to name what it locates. Type-only imports of AuthenticationService and SidebarProvider, so no runtime coupling and no cycle. Measured before ratifying: extracting interfaces does not work (both are CLASSES, and AuthenticationService has 44 public methods across 855 lines, so the copy would drift), and converting callers does not either (all 48 are handlers, commands or MCP tools, which the rule explicitly permits to fetch). The alternative considered and rejected was a typed-token registry, which removes the naming but rewrites the DI shape and 50+ call sites. PERMANENT EXCEPTION, not debt.

_layerDirection_note: Direction rule: nothing under src/core/ imports @/features or @/commands. Ratified 2026-08-30 after the rule was found stated as law in src/core/CLAUDE.md, present in NO handbook/ADR/convention, enforced by nothing, and violated seven times. Webview files are out of scope (isWebview), so core/ui/ is excluded. The set may only shrink: clearing a file means fixing it AND deleting its row.
_godFileCandidates_note: A CEILING, seeded at 68 on 2026-09-10 and pinned by god-file-ratchet.test.ts. Source files over the size limit CLAUDE.md and /sop-scan Agent 11 both state: service >400, component >350, handler >500, util >300, with Agent 11's exclusions. THE POPULATION, not the work list — see godFileCoupled for that. This is the first time the rule has had any cadence: godFile in tests/sop was the CSS one, the tooling registry holds no source-size instrument, and the sweep ran none, so it only ever ran when a person typed /sop-scan.
_godFileCoupled_note: A CEILING, seeded at 31 on 2026-09-10. Files over threshold that ALSO show a coupling signal — the actual decomposition work list. decompose-god-file is explicit that a file over threshold WITHOUT coupling should be left alone, which is why there are two numbers: pinning only the population would reward splitting cohesive files to move a number. Signals counted are the ones a script can: >15 non-type imports, >10 public surface, >7 constructor deps.
